findings.classification: confirmed code defect with live-run impact
findings.title: 丢弃不足16 chunk的尾批，同时丢掉终局任务奖励
findings.evidence: 65 completed cycles: 15 last receipts are skipped=true (30 episode tails). thawing_frozen_food final Q=[0.2222222222222222,0.0], terminal tail=8 chunks, skipped. A stdlib-only AST extraction of the original dispatch reproduced deletion of all 8 experiences without calling update.
findings.impact: Terminal reward is 10*Q and paid only at task end. Dropping the final batch omits that actor/critic target and terminal potential correction; previous batches were already bootstrapped and updated, not recomputed with this final return. Intermediate shaping can still have provided some signal; do not claim all information about that episode was lost.
findings.recommendation: Train valid small terminal batches, or plan an on-policy batch boundary retaining terminal data before any optimizer update; never drop terminal samples solely to reach a batch-size threshold. Regression cases: tails of 1-15 chunks, both success/failure, actual controls duration and zero-advantage handling.

findings.classification: confirmed code inconsistency; numerical impact unmeasured
findings.title: 批次边界bootstrap用旧子目标，下一次动作却可能用新子目标
findings.evidence: value() reuses slots[index].projection without scheduled replan; infer() replans at chunks%8==0. With 2 envs/64 chunks, normal flushes occur every32 chunks per env, also replanning boundaries. Logs contain 33 skill changes at such boundaries.
findings.impact: The final next_value in a collection batch can refer to a different skill-conditioned policy state than the next actually executed policy. The 33 count is observed mismatches in semantic skills, not a measurement of value error; parent-goal-only changes may add cases.
findings.recommendation: Prepare/cache the next admitted high-level context once per observation boundary, use it for bootstrap and subsequent inference, and ensure memory is committed only once. Test NAVIGATE-to-GRASP boundary with deliberately different critic values.

findings.title: 保存了失败诊断日志，但未保存可复用的完整失败轨迹
findings.evidence: Observation/local_subgoal/flow chain are RAM-only experiences deleted after update. Simulator launched with --no-write-video. Entire current run file-suffix inventory has no RGB/video/array trajectory files; .pt files are latest/previous model checkpoints. action_audit contains task/min/max/mean_abs/finite only.
findings.available: Per-control reward, official Q/success, skill potentials, literal/grasp diagnostics; planner events; terminal instance/steps/Q/success JSON; optimizer receipts.
findings.absent: Durable aligned RGB/proprio/raw23 executed actions, experience-to-episode/policy-update mapping, simulator replay states. Planner log lacks episode-instance/run/time identity; action audit even lacks env/step.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded, compressed durable episode recorder with task/instance/seed/policy version, chunk/step timestamps, images/proprio/raw23 actions, admitted intent and reward/termination fields. Preserve failures as well as successes and split by source instance. Old missing observations/actions cannot be recovered from summary statistics.

findings.classification: measured conservative update regime; not by itself proof of causal failure
findings.title: 动作专家确有更新，但学习步幅很小
findings.evidence: All captured updates accept actor_lr=1e-8 at first attempt; mean post-update KL approximately0.00039 vs target0.05, mean clip fraction approximately0.00013 (0.013%). Logged first actor tensor max change is typically1.49e-8 per update; this is one tensor, not full-model drift.
findings.recommendation: After correctness fixes, use a bounded fixed-data comparison to calibrate actor step size by realized KL and executed-action drift, with the existing rollback guard. Do not blindly multiply LR or interpret low KL as proof that larger LR will improve task success.

findings.classification: observed hierarchical bottleneck; attribution still incomplete
findings.title: 冻结高层下大量技能条件重复，低层RL不能直接改高层
findings.evidence: Radio:52 planner events across2 full training episodes, all NAVIGATE radio_89; no grasp TRUE in either physical log. Across sampled run, about99% successive per-task/per-env skill bundles are identical,30/73 visited tasks have only one unique bundle. Repetition alone is not necessarily an error when a skill legitimately persists.
findings.limitation: No video/replay to distinguish wrong perception/plan switching from low-level failure to reach the waypoint. No physical previous-outcome feedback is supplied; high and low VLM frozen.
findings.recommendation: Separate planning versus execution with small matched diagnostic rollouts and observable outcome feedback before expecting low-only RL to learn high-level recovery. Privileged reward state stays outside deployed actor/planner.

findings.title: 更新日志没有保留advantage/return/value拟合质量
findings.evidence: evaluate_prepared computes policy/value loss but report omits them; no raw advantage mean/std/sign, return distribution, value targets/predictions, or explained variance saved.
findings.recommendation: Log these with reward components, nonzero-Q fraction and task/instance/policy version. Finite gradients/ratio1 demonstrate numerical execution, not effective credit assignment.

checks_not_flagged_as_bugs: Live counters increased across snapshots; actor gradient and nonzero parameter-change guards pass. This is genuine RL updating, not merely serving.
Stored/recomputed unchanged-policy KL is zero in captured updates; flow likelihood uses stored Gaussian transition chains and active dimensions, not an FM loss masquerading as log probability.
Stage1 uses single-frame RGB/proprio, pad indices [7,8,17,18], decodes real23 controls and executes first16 of32 starting at0. Low checkpoint restoration verifies all192 trained LoRA tensors.
Reward uses potential differences plus terminal officialQ; privileges stay in reward diagnostics and critic-only remaining-time feature, outside actor/planner templates.
Manifest separates train/dev/SFT-heldout instances; this audit did not repeat the original full data membership verification.
Normal per-control official horizon from catalog is int(1.5*human_mean_length); normalized_time near2/3 in output is not evidence of a2/3-budget bug.
No new GPU validation or full multimodal deployment equivalence test was run; code guards do not establish universal correctness.
